A healthy alternative to instant ramen? UK
Lots of the times I would have instant ramen - seasoned with soy sauce and seasame oil and salt. It’s the noodles themselves that I like. 

Does anywhere sell bulk plain ramen noodles (not deep fried)? I see that there’s ottogi but they are so expensive, £1.8 per pack. 

Or is there an alternative? What I’ve been doing was buying instant ramen and just discarding the seasoning packets.
